blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) has tightened procedures for taxpayers seeking refunds of excess taxes, requiring them to submit complete documents before the agency begins its 180-day processing period. Under Revenue Memorandum Circular No. 102-2026, the BIR clarified the mandatory requirements for claims involving excess or unutilized creditable withholding taxes (CWT). READ: BIR clears VAT refunds for exporters before certification The BIR said individuals or corporations may either request a refund of their excess income taxes or carry over the amount to succeeding taxable years.
